text.text_excerpt: They have some pretty good music. A great place to go hang out outside with your friends and take it slow, as most of this town does. I ordered the fried appetizer sampler with alligator, crawfish and shrimp. It was really good. But the best part? The ice cream daiquiris. I got the pina colada, and it was delicious. It was cool and refreshing, no heaviness as ice cream can sometimes be. I will definitely be back to drink more of their ice cream daiquiris. The only reason why i say this place is $$ versus $ is because you're going to want to order more than 1 drink.

I came in here for a quick bite and break from the sun while walking around the French Market and surrounding parts of the French Quarter. There was a live band playing while I was eating, which was pretty cool. I wound up ordering a cup of gumbo and half a muffuletta. The gumbo was great, as I expected. The muffuletta was pretty good as well. It was only a half order, but it was gigantic! I assume a full order of it would be enough for 2 people, lol. As far as the service goes, it was quick and friendly as well. I recommend this place if you want a quick bite while listening to some good tunes.

We stopped in here for a drink and a rest in January when other nearby cafes either were overstuffed or had decidedly subpar musical accompaniment. The tight live band and the heaters on the patio first caught our attention. But hey, I think we found the best spot near the square after all. Their Pina Coladas are made with fresh coconut and whipped cream and frankly were some of the best I've tasted anywhere. But on a chilly day, the hot Irish Twins Jameson-based drink totally hit the spot. I would stop in again for that drink alone. We got brave and ordered a sampler platter with fried shrimp, crawfish and alligator. Those last two were not my thing, but definitely satisfied the curiosit...
